rules.sentence: Smartwatch-based wearable oximeters have shown reliability in detecting oxygen desaturation at high altitudes and may predict AMS risk.[18]
Accurate differentiation among COVID-19 pneumonia, HAPE, and ARDS is essential, as each condition requires a different therapeutic approach.
